patterns: PYQs ask single identifications: 'Pivot to Asia' = USA; Larry Pressler = curbs on US military aid to Pakistan.
Exercise-location/service one-liners (Yudh Abhyas = Army; 2009 edition in MP).
Expect foundational-agreement order/purpose (GSOMIA, LEMOA, COMCASA, BECA) and year items (MDP 2016).
App MCQs are heavier on 2023-25 current affairs (iCET/TRUST, Mission 500) than the PYQs, which are older and factual.
